meta.title: Kilumen creature design sheet (Kilindex 450)
rules: Original designs only; Pokemon is structure reference only.
Every creature carries a violet dominance crystal; Cosmic variants recolour the body only and keep violet crystals.
Attack effects belong to skills, not creatures.
Types: first = main element row, second = sub-element (DD 8 main + 15 sub). normal is not used for creatures.

size_classes.small: small (~64 px in a 128 battle frame)

creatures.name: Tumbloam
creatures.visual_brief: Roly-poly woodlouse/wombat pup; banded slate shell with moss specks, stubby stone nose horn, rounded legs. Palette: slate grey, moss green, sand, violet. Crystal: tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Stubborn and loyal; curls into a ball when shy and rolls down riverbanks packing soil into burrows.

creatures.name: Burrowmane
creatures.visual_brief: Stockier wombat-badger; shell bands now shoulder plates, thick shaggy moss mane around neck, short nose horn. Palette: slate grey, moss green, sand, violet. Crystal: tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Watches over smaller creatures like an older sibling.

creatures.name: Bastonox
creatures.visual_brief: Fortress-shelled tank on pillar legs; layered slate shell like a rampart, heavy brow horn, moss in the seams; violet crystal clusters on both shoulders. Palette: slate grey, moss green, sand, violet. Crystal: tail tip.
creatures.flavour: A patient guardian. Old stories say a herd once walled off a whole valley.

creatures.name: Cindrip
creatures.visual_brief: Charcoal tapir calf; short trunk-snout, lava-coal plates on back and haunches, glowing seams. Palette: charcoal, ember orange, ash grey, violet. Crystal: violet veins along the plates, crystal at tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Sniffs everything it meets, then sneezes sparks at it.

creatures.name: Emberlunx
creatures.visual_brief: Lean deer-legged tapir; long legs, coal spine crest that glows when running. Palette: charcoal, ember orange, ash grey, violet. Crystal: violet veins along the plates, crystal at tail tip.
creatures.flavour: A restless sprinter with a crest of glowing coal down its spine.

creatures.name: Forgeharrow
creatures.visual_brief: Elk-sized tapir; ember-venting spine ridge, forge-plate shoulders, antler-like coal crest. Palette: charcoal, ember orange, ash grey, violet. Crystal: violet veins along the plates, crystal at tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Proud and honourable. Smiths once used its breath to fire their kilns.

creatures.name: Rillop
creatures.visual_brief: Otter-cuttlefish pup; frill-fin skirt, tendril whiskers, big eyes. Palette: seafoam, teal, cream, violet. Crystal: tail tip (Tidemarrow: violet beads on coral horns).
creatures.flavour: A playful river pup. Its tendril whiskers find every loose pebble.

creatures.name: Brookhorn
creatures.visual_brief: Sleek otter with stubby coral horns and longer frill fins. Palette: seafoam, teal, cream, violet. Crystal: tail tip (Tidemarrow: violet beads on coral horns).
creatures.flavour: Brave and a bit of a show-off. Its coral horns grow with every season.

creatures.name: Tidemarrow
creatures.visual_brief: Long sea-otter body; branching coral horns strung with violet beads, broad wing fins. Palette: seafoam, teal, cream, violet. Crystal: tail tip (Tidemarrow: violet beads on coral horns).
creatures.flavour: Calm and wise. Sailors read its moods to guess the weather.

creatures.name: Peeplark
creatures.visual_brief: Round fluff-ball lark; stub wings, oversized feet, one curled head feather. Palette: wheat brown, cream, sky blue, violet. Crystal: small gem on the forehead, grows into a crest stone.
creatures.flavour: Sings at the first light and never on key.

creatures.name: Larkspar
creatures.visual_brief: Slim lark; long split tail, swept crest, bold blue wing bars. Palette: wheat brown, cream, sky blue, violet. Crystal: small gem on the forehead, grows into a crest stone.
creatures.flavour: Spars with its own reflection in puddles.

creatures.name: Galespar
creatures.visual_brief: Broad-winged hawk-lark; crest swept back like a blade, banded tail fan, wings open wide. Palette: wheat brown, cream, sky blue, violet. Crystal: small gem on the forehead, grows into a crest stone.
creatures.flavour: Rides the first gust of a storm to scout ahead of the rain.

creatures.name: Nibbin
creatures.visual_brief: Chubby field vole; huge round ears, stuffed cheeks, twitchy whiskers. Palette: fawn, cream, cocoa, violet. Crystal: crystal set in the tip of one ear.
creatures.flavour: Hides seeds in every hole it can find and forgets half of them.

creatures.name: Gnawford
creatures.visual_brief: Stout beaver-vole; flat paddle tail, chisel front teeth, little stick bundle on its back. Palette: fawn, cream, cocoa, violet. Crystal: crystal set in the tip of one ear.
creatures.flavour: Builds tiny dams across puddles and charges a toll of one berry.

creatures.name: Dewmite
creatures.visual_brief: Tiny green caterpillar; dewdrop bubble on its back, stubby leaf-shaped feet. Palette: leaf green, dew blue, pale gold, violet. Crystal: bead on the tail segment, later between the wings.
creatures.flavour: Drinks only the first dew of the morning.

creatures.name: Huskling
creatures.visual_brief: Leaf-wrapped cocoon hanging from a stem; two eyes peek out. Palette: leaf green, dew blue, pale gold, violet. Crystal: bead on the tail segment, later between the wings.
creatures.flavour: Sways with the wind and pretends to be asleep.

creatures.name: Gauzewing
creatures.visual_brief: Delicate moth; translucent gauze wings with gold veins, feathery antennae. Palette: leaf green, dew blue, pale gold, violet. Crystal: bead on the tail segment, later between the wings.
creatures.flavour: Its wing dust leaves a faint glow on flowers it visits.

creatures.name: Cloverkin
creatures.visual_brief: Little rabbit with four clover-leaf ears and a puff tail. Palette: clover green, white, pink, violet. Crystal: tiny crystal on its nose.
creatures.flavour: Brings luck to anyone who shares a snack with it, or so kids say.

creatures.name: Puddlenip
creatures.visual_brief: Squat frog shaped like a raindrop; wide mouth, splayed toes. Palette: puddle blue, grey, yellow belly, violet. Crystal: crystal on top of its head like a raindrop.
creatures.flavour: Only comes out when storm floods fill the grass.
creatures.note: Storm/flood slot companion to Rillop on route1_storm.

creatures.name: Hushowl
creatures.visual_brief: Round owlet; heart-shaped face, oversized amber eyes, fluffy down. Palette: dusk violet-grey, cream, amber eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal in the facial disc.
creatures.flavour: Makes no sound at all, even when it sneezes.

creatures.name: Vesperowl
creatures.visual_brief: Tall owl in a cloak of dark feathers; tufted brows, long silent wings. Palette: dusk violet-grey, cream, amber eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal in the facial disc.
creatures.flavour: Guards the night roads and guides travellers who walk quietly.

creatures.name: Mumblet
creatures.visual_brief: Little floating cloud-sprite with a round mouth and stubby arms. Palette: lavender, cream, soft teal, violet. Crystal: crystal floats above its head.
creatures.flavour: Repeats the last word anyone said, very slowly.

creatures.name: Thistlepup
creatures.visual_brief: Puppy with a spiky thistle-head ruff and soft round body. Palette: thistle purple, sage green, tan, violet. Crystal: crystal at the base of the tail.
creatures.flavour: Gets its fur stuck to everything and is proud of it.

creatures.name: Thistlehound
creatures.visual_brief: Lean hound with a mane of thistle spikes and a burr-tufted tail. Palette: thistle purple, sage green, tan, violet. Crystal: crystal at the base of the tail.
creatures.flavour: A loyal tracker; burrs on its tail mark the trail home.

creatures.name: Puffwhirl
creatures.visual_brief: Dandelion seed-puff with a tiny face and two leaf feet. Palette: white, pale yellow, sky blue, violet. Crystal: seed-crystal at the centre of the puff.
creatures.flavour: Drifts wherever the wind goes and is never lost.

creatures.name: Pebblant
creatures.visual_brief: Red ant carrying a pebble twice its size. Palette: rust red, clay, black, violet. Crystal: crystal pebble carried in the jaws.
creatures.flavour: Never puts its pebble down, not even to sleep.

creatures.name: Cairnant
creatures.visual_brief: Big ant with a stacked stone cairn grown on its back. Palette: rust red, clay, black, violet. Crystal: crystal pebble carried in the jaws.
creatures.flavour: Builds marker towers that point the way to water.

creatures.name: Glintfly
creatures.visual_brief: Firefly with a round glowing tail and tiny wings. Palette: warm gold, cream, soft green, violet. Crystal: crystal is the glowing abdomen.
creatures.flavour: Blinks in patterns that other Glintfly answer from far away.

creatures.name: Beaconfly
creatures.visual_brief: Larger firefly with a lantern-shaped tail and four broad wings. Palette: warm gold, cream, soft green, violet. Crystal: crystal is the glowing abdomen.
creatures.flavour: A swarm lights up the meadow on summer nights.

creatures.name: Flickermole
creatures.visual_brief: Velvety mole; glowing ember snout, broad digging claws. Palette: charcoal brown, ember orange, pink nose, violet. Crystal: crystal on its digging claws.
creatures.flavour: Leaves warm little tunnels under frosty fields.

creatures.name: Sailquill
creatures.visual_brief: Blue-white swift with a sail crest and streamer tail. Palette: blue-white, sky blue, violet. Crystal: violet beads on the streamer tail.
creatures.flavour: A cheerful messenger that rides in on storm fronts.
creatures.note: Notes say evolution TBD; kept single here (Gary to decide).

creatures.name: Halovy
creatures.visual_brief: Moth-fawn with a halo ring above its head and soft wing-ears. Palette: cream, soft gold, pale pink, violet. Crystal: violet crystals set in the halo ring.
creatures.flavour: Gentle and shy. It shows up at dawn for travellers who are lost.

creatures.name: Gloamtick
creatures.visual_brief: Floating big-eared dormouse-bat; wispy dew lower body, carries a little lantern by its tail. Palette: dusk grey, dew white, amber glow, violet. Crystal: crystal lantern carried by the tail.
creatures.flavour: A timid trickster. Carries a little crystal lantern by its tail.

creatures.name: Burlbeetle
creatures.visual_brief: Tree-burl beetle with a mushroom cap on its back. Palette: bark brown, mushroom tan, moss green, violet. Crystal: violet knots in the bark.
creatures.flavour: Sleepy and sturdy. Hides in plain sight by pretending to be a stump.

creatures.name: Dartling
creatures.visual_brief: Minnow with oversized fins and a startled face. Palette: silver, river green, orange fins, violet. Crystal: crystal on the dorsal fin.
creatures.flavour: Darts in schools; one sneeze scatters them all.

creatures.name: Streambarb
creatures.visual_brief: Barbel fish with whisker feelers and striped flanks. Palette: silver, river green, orange fins, violet. Crystal: crystal on the dorsal fin.
creatures.flavour: Reads the riverbed with its whiskers like a map.

creatures.name: Torrentpike
creatures.visual_brief: Long torpedo pike; jagged jaw, fin blades along the back. Palette: silver, river green, orange fins, violet. Crystal: crystal on the dorsal fin.
creatures.flavour: Leaps waterfalls in a single bound.

creatures.name: Musselin
creatures.visual_brief: Mussel shell with two stubby feet and peeking eyes. Palette: mussel blue-black, pearl, moss, violet. Crystal: a violet pearl inside the shell.
creatures.flavour: Clamps onto boots and refuses to let go.

creatures.name: Eftling
creatures.visual_brief: Little newt with orange spots and a frilled tail. Palette: olive, orange spots, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal on the back of the head.
creatures.flavour: Basks on warm stones by the riverbank all afternoon.

creatures.name: Eftwarden
creatures.visual_brief: Larger newt with a gilled frill crown and long paddle tail. Palette: olive, orange spots, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal on the back of the head.
creatures.flavour: Patrols the shallows and chases off anything bigger than it.

creatures.name: Frondlet
creatures.visual_brief: Fawn with curled fern-fiddlehead ears and dappled back. Palette: fern green, bark brown, cream spots, violet. Crystal: crystal between the antlers.
creatures.flavour: Unrolls its ears to listen when someone calls its name.

creatures.name: Frondhart
creatures.visual_brief: Young deer with fern-frond antlers. Palette: fern green, bark brown, cream spots, violet. Crystal: crystal between the antlers.
creatures.flavour: Leads lost travellers out of tall ferns.

creatures.name: Fernstag
creatures.visual_brief: Tall stag with sweeping fern antlers and a moss collar. Palette: fern green, bark brown, cream spots, violet. Crystal: crystal between the antlers.
creatures.flavour: Fernwick folk say the town was planted where one rested.

creatures.name: Shellbloom
creatures.visual_brief: Snail whose spiral shell is a blooming flower bud. Palette: moss green, pink bloom, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal is the flower centre.
creatures.flavour: Moves slowly from garden to garden and leaves them greener.

creatures.name: Pondkin
creatures.visual_brief: Duckling-like tadpole wearing a lily pad as a hat. Palette: pond green, reed tan, lily pink, violet. Crystal: crystal on the lily pad hat.
creatures.flavour: Paddles in circles until it gets dizzy.

creatures.name: Reedmoot
creatures.visual_brief: Heron-shaped amphibian with reed legs and a lily crown. Palette: pond green, reed tan, lily pink, violet. Crystal: crystal on the lily pad hat.
creatures.flavour: Stands still in the pond for hours, thinking.

creatures.name: Hearthkit
creatures.visual_brief: Kitten with warm-glowing paw pads and a curled tail flame. Palette: cinnamon, cream, warm orange, violet. Crystal: crystal on the collar tuft.
creatures.flavour: Sleeps on doorsteps to keep them warm.

creatures.name: Kilnpaw
creatures.visual_brief: Lean cat with brick-pattern fur and ember-tipped ears. Palette: cinnamon, cream, warm orange, violet. Crystal: crystal on the collar tuft.
creatures.flavour: Bakers leave a bun out for one, and it keeps the oven lit.

creatures.name: Wickerling
creatures.visual_brief: Little woven-basket figure with ribbon arms. Palette: wicker tan, ribbon red, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal sits in its woven chest.
creatures.flavour: Collects lost buttons and keeps them inside itself.

creatures.name: Dustbonnet
creatures.visual_brief: Small sheet-ghost wearing a frilled bonnet. Palette: faded linen, dusty blue, black eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal pinned to the bonnet.
creatures.flavour: Tidies abandoned attics at night and leaves no footprints.

creatures.name: Ledgedove
creatures.visual_brief: Plump dove with a puffed chest and tiny feet. Palette: slate blue, rose grey, white, violet. Crystal: crystal on the chest.
creatures.flavour: Coos from rooftops and warns the town of rain.

creatures.name: Belfrydove
creatures.visual_brief: Elegant dove with bell-shaped tail fan and long wings. Palette: slate blue, rose grey, white, violet. Crystal: crystal on the chest.
creatures.flavour: Rings the old belfry by landing on the rope.

creatures.name: Capling
creatures.visual_brief: Tiny mushroom with stubby legs and a spotted cap. Palette: red cap, cream spots, toad green, violet. Crystal: crystal on the cap tip.
creatures.flavour: Pops up overnight after rain in neat little rings.

creatures.name: Toadcap
creatures.visual_brief: Squat toad wearing a broad spotted mushroom cap. Palette: red cap, cream spots, toad green, violet. Crystal: crystal on the cap tip.
creatures.flavour: Croaks spores into the air that make the garden grow.

creatures.name: Candlewren
creatures.visual_brief: Tiny wren with a candle-flame crest that never goes out. Palette: candle white, warm gold, soft blue, violet. Crystal: crystal is the flame on its head.
creatures.flavour: Sits in windows on long nights so no one feels alone.

creatures.name: Cobblepup
creatures.visual_brief: Puppy whose coat is a pattern of rounded cobblestones. Palette: cobble grey, moss, brown eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal set as a collar stone.
creatures.flavour: Fetches stones instead of sticks and stacks them by the door.

creatures.name: Hummbel
creatures.visual_brief: Fuzzy round bee with tiny wings. Palette: honey gold, black bands, white wings, violet. Crystal: crystal in the honeycomb pattern.
creatures.flavour: Hums a tune that makes flowers turn toward it.

creatures.name: Combwarden
creatures.visual_brief: Big guard bee with a honeycomb shield-shaped thorax. Palette: honey gold, black bands, white wings, violet. Crystal: crystal in the honeycomb pattern.
creatures.flavour: Keeps the town gardens safe and sweet.

creatures.name: Lintmouse
creatures.visual_brief: Mouse made of soft lint with mismatched patch ears. Palette: lint grey, pink nose, patchwork colours, violet. Crystal: crystal button on its belly.
creatures.flavour: Lives in laundry baskets and steals single socks.

creatures.name: Weathervex
creatures.visual_brief: Rooster-shaped wind sprite with an arrow tail that spins. Palette: copper green, rust, sky grey, violet. Crystal: crystal at the arrow tip of its tail.
creatures.flavour: Always faces where the wind will come from next.

creatures.name: Briarlet
creatures.visual_brief: Round piglet with bramble bristles and a berry-red snout. Palette: bramble green, bark brown, berry red, violet. Crystal: crystal on the snout tip, later between the tusks.
creatures.flavour: Roots for berries and comes back covered in scratches, happy.

creatures.name: Bramblehog
creatures.visual_brief: Stocky boar-pig with a bramble ridge down its back. Palette: bramble green, bark brown, berry red, violet. Crystal: crystal on the snout tip, later between the tusks.
creatures.flavour: Charges through thickets to open new paths.

creatures.name: Thornhusk
creatures.visual_brief: Huge boar with a thorn-armoured hide and curved wooden tusks. Palette: bramble green, bark brown, berry red, violet. Crystal: crystal on the snout tip, later between the tusks.
creatures.flavour: Old woodcutters asked it before felling any tree.

creatures.name: Nettlegrub
creatures.visual_brief: Fat green grub covered in soft nettle hairs. Palette: nettle green, cream, thorn brown, violet. Crystal: crystal bead on the head, later on the lance horn.
creatures.flavour: Munches leaves loudly enough to hear across a clearing.

creatures.name: Thornpod
creatures.visual_brief: Spiky seed-pod cocoon wedged in a thorn bush. Palette: nettle green, cream, thorn brown, violet. Crystal: crystal bead on the head, later on the lance horn.
creatures.flavour: Do not touch. It wriggles if you stare at it.

creatures.name: Lancebeetle
creatures.visual_brief: Rhino-beetle with a long lance horn and bark-plated wing cases. Palette: nettle green, cream, thorn brown, violet. Crystal: crystal bead on the head, later on the lance horn.
creatures.flavour: Duels other beetles at dawn and bows after each one.

creatures.name: Acornip
creatures.visual_brief: Squirrel kit wearing an acorn cap, puffy tail. Palette: acorn brown, leaf green, cream belly, violet. Crystal: crystal in the acorn cap.
creatures.flavour: Buries acorns and grows forests by accident.

creatures.name: Oakscurry
creatures.visual_brief: Long-bodied squirrel with oak-leaf tail fan and bark-striped back. Palette: acorn brown, leaf green, cream belly, violet. Crystal: crystal in the acorn cap.
creatures.flavour: Leaps tree to tree carrying messages for the forest.

creatures.name: Shadevix
creatures.visual_brief: Slim fox kit with oversized ears and a shadow-dark mask. Palette: charcoal, rust, ash grey, violet. Crystal: crystal at the tip of the brush tail.
creatures.flavour: Steals pebbles from paths, but only the dull grey ones.

creatures.name: Duskbrush
creatures.visual_brief: Elegant fox with a huge brush tail that fades into shadow. Palette: charcoal, rust, ash grey, violet. Crystal: crystal at the tip of the brush tail.
creatures.flavour: Paints the forest floor with its tail so it can vanish in the dusk.

creatures.name: Pipistrix
creatures.visual_brief: Tiny bat with leaf-shaped wings and a crinkled nose leaf. Palette: leaf brown, membrane tan, pink ears, violet. Crystal: crystal on the nose leaf.
creatures.flavour: Hangs in rows under branches like dried leaves.

creatures.name: Silkwick
creatures.visual_brief: Fluffy round spider with silk tufts and eight short legs. Palette: silk white, moss green, amber eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal at the web centre on its back.
creatures.flavour: Spins tiny webs that catch morning dew, not bugs.

creatures.name: Loomweaver
creatures.visual_brief: Long-legged spider with a loom-frame web strung between its legs. Palette: silk white, moss green, amber eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal at the web centre on its back.
creatures.flavour: Weaves patterns no one has taught it.

creatures.name: Knothaunt
creatures.visual_brief: A walking stump with a knot-hole face and root feet. Palette: grey bark, hollow black, mossy green, violet. Crystal: crystal glints inside the knot-hole mouth.
creatures.flavour: Moves only when no one looks; campers wake to find it closer.

creatures.name: Mossloth
creatures.visual_brief: Sloth with a coat of moss and tiny ferns sprouting. Palette: moss green, grey fur, cream face, violet. Crystal: crystal on its belly fur.
creatures.flavour: Has not been in a hurry once in its life.

creatures.name: Tappeck
creatures.visual_brief: Small woodpecker with a red crest and stiff tail. Palette: red crest, black-white bars, bark brown, violet. Crystal: crystal at the base of the beak.
creatures.flavour: Taps a rhythm on trees that other creatures dance to.

creatures.name: Drumcrest
creatures.visual_brief: Bold woodpecker with a tall crest and heavy beak. Palette: red crest, black-white bars, bark brown, violet. Crystal: crystal at the base of the beak.
creatures.flavour: Its drumming can be heard from the next valley.

creatures.name: Gleamcap
creatures.visual_brief: Glowing mushroom with tiny arms and a lantern-like cap. Palette: soft blue glow, cream stalk, teal spots, violet. Crystal: crystal set in the cap.
creatures.flavour: Lights the forest floor in rings at night.

creatures.name: Ivyadder
creatures.visual_brief: Thin snake with ivy-leaf scales and a leafy tail. Palette: ivy green, yellow belly, dark stripe, violet. Crystal: crystal on the tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Wraps around branches and pretends to be a vine.

creatures.name: Verdasp
creatures.visual_brief: Long hooded snake with a leaf-frill hood. Palette: ivy green, yellow belly, dark stripe, violet. Crystal: crystal on the tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Hisses like wind through leaves to warn intruders away.

creatures.name: Spinelet
creatures.visual_brief: Round hedgehog with soft spines and a tiny snout. Palette: brown spines, cream face, black nose, violet. Crystal: crystal set among the back spines.
creatures.flavour: Rolls into a ball at the slightest noise.

creatures.name: Thornmound
creatures.visual_brief: Hedgehog with a mound of hard stone-tipped spines. Palette: brown spines, cream face, black nose, violet. Crystal: crystal set among the back spines.
creatures.flavour: Sleeps in a hillock and is mistaken for one.

creatures.name: Sigilmoth
creatures.visual_brief: Moth whose wings carry glowing circle patterns. Palette: plum, gold sigils, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal forms one of the wing sigils.
creatures.flavour: The patterns on its wings change every full moon.

creatures.name: Oakenward
creatures.visual_brief: Tall tree-guardian with branch arms and a moss-bearded face. Palette: old oak brown, moss green, pale gold eyes, violet. Crystal: violet crystal heartwood visible in a split in the trunk.
creatures.flavour: Sleeps for decades; wakes only if the forest is threatened.

creatures.name: Twigling
creatures.visual_brief: Stick insect with leaf-bud joints and thin legs. Palette: twig brown, leaf green, tan, violet. Crystal: tiny crystal bud on its head.
creatures.flavour: Has been stepped on twice and forgave both times.

creatures.name: Thornfinch
creatures.visual_brief: Finch with a thorn-tipped crest and berry-stained beak. Palette: olive, rust breast, thorn grey, violet. Crystal: crystal on the breast.
creatures.flavour: Nests in the thorniest bushes, where nothing can reach.

creatures.name: Imprick
creatures.visual_brief: Mischievous imp with thorn horns and a barbed tail. Palette: deep red, thorn black, yellow eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal between its two horns.
creatures.flavour: Swaps signposts around the forest for fun.

creatures.name: Flockpup
creatures.visual_brief: Fluffy sheepdog pup with patched fur. Palette: black-white patches, tan, violet. Crystal: crystal on the collar.
creatures.flavour: Herds anything: sheep, ducks, other Flockpup.

creatures.name: Flockward
creatures.visual_brief: Tall collie-like dog with a thick ruff and keen eyes. Palette: black-white patches, tan, violet. Crystal: crystal on the collar.
creatures.flavour: Farmers trust one with a whole flock and a week alone.

creatures.name: Bleatling
creatures.visual_brief: Goat kid with nub horns and curly cream wool. Palette: cream wool, horn grey, brown face, violet. Crystal: crystal set between the horns.
creatures.flavour: Climbs onto fences and won't come down.

creatures.name: Hornwall
creatures.visual_brief: Broad goat with curled stone-like horns forming a shield. Palette: cream wool, horn grey, brown face, violet. Crystal: crystal set between the horns.
creatures.flavour: Holds narrow paths against anything.

creatures.name: Crowkin
creatures.visual_brief: Scruffy crow chick with a too-big beak. Palette: glossy black, blue sheen, grey beak, violet. Crystal: crystal hangs as a charm around its neck.
creatures.flavour: Collects buttons and trades them with other Crowkin.

creatures.name: Rookmantle
creatures.visual_brief: Large crow with a cape of feathers and a shrewd stare. Palette: glossy black, blue sheen, grey beak, violet. Crystal: crystal hangs as a charm around its neck.
creatures.flavour: Remembers every face it has met and every favour owed.

creatures.name: Strawhaunt
creatures.visual_brief: Scarecrow with a burlap face and straw hands, floating a little off the ground. Palette: straw yellow, burlap tan, patch blue, violet. Crystal: crystal shows through a stitched chest patch.
creatures.flavour: Guards fields at night and is lonely during the day.

creatures.name: Grainling
creatures.visual_brief: Tiny wheat-stalk creature with a grain head. Palette: wheat gold, green stalk, brown, violet. Crystal: crystal grain on top of the head.
creatures.flavour: Sways with the field and giggles in the breeze.

creatures.name: Sheafguard
creatures.visual_brief: Bundled sheaf figure with a sickle-shaped leaf arm. Palette: wheat gold, green stalk, brown, violet. Crystal: crystal grain on top of the head.
creatures.flavour: Watches the harvest and shares it with birds.

creatures.name: Millwhirl
creatures.visual_brief: Spinning windmill-shaped sprite with four sail arms. Palette: white, sail tan, sky blue, violet. Crystal: crystal at the hub of its sails.
creatures.flavour: Spins faster the happier it is.

creatures.name: Foalgust
creatures.visual_brief: Gangly foal with a cloud-puff mane. Palette: dapple grey, white mane, sky blue, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, later a crystal in the mane.
creatures.flavour: Runs in circles just to feel the wind.

creatures.name: Stridegale
creatures.visual_brief: Lean horse with a streaming wind mane and feathered hooves. Palette: dapple grey, white mane, sky blue, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, later a crystal in the mane.
creatures.flavour: Outruns storms across the plains.

creatures.name: Tempesteed
creatures.visual_brief: Powerful horse with storm-cloud mane and rain-streak tail. Palette: dapple grey, white mane, sky blue, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, later a crystal in the mane.
creatures.flavour: Its gallop brings rain to dry fields.

creatures.name: Dashhare

creatures.name: Gargolet

creatures.name: Gildmane

creatures.name: Crownmane

creatures.name: Pinchkin

creatures.name: Brinepipit

creatures.name: Spraytern

creatures.visual_brief: Sleek seal with a ruff of kelp around its neck. Palette: grey dapple, white whiskers, ivory tusks, violet. Crystal: crystal on the nose, final wears crystal studs on the tusks.

creatures.name: Tuskwallow

creatures.name: Sandstarlet

creatures.flavour: Holds still for days, waiting to be warm enough to move.

creatures.name: Olmling
creatures.visual_brief: Pale cave salamander with feathery red gills. Palette: pale pink, white, frilled gills red, violet. Crystal: crystal on the snout.
creatures.flavour: Lives a very long time and is never in a hurry.

creatures.name: Stonepede
creatures.visual_brief: Centipede with stone segments. Palette: grey segments, rust legs, bone white, violet. Crystal: crystal on the head plate.
creatures.flavour: Clicks along cave walls in long lines.

creatures.name: Columnpede
creatures.visual_brief: Huge centipede that coils around stone columns. Palette: grey segments, rust legs, bone white, violet. Crystal: crystal on the head plate.
creatures.flavour: Can hold a cave roof up in a collapse.

creatures.name: Humstone
creatures.visual_brief: Standing stone with carved lines that glow and hum. Palette: granite grey, glowing blue lines, violet. Crystal: crystal set in the central carved rune.
creatures.flavour: Hums deeper the closer danger gets.

creatures.name: Slagrook
creatures.visual_brief: Hermit crab in a kiln-chimney shell with a furnace window. Palette: kiln brick red, charcoal grey, ember orange, violet. Crystal: violet furnace window in the shell.
creatures.flavour: A hoarder that swaps shells at abandoned forges.
creatures.note: Encounters place it in Greystone; notes also list Cindervale.

creatures.name: Frostlop
creatures.visual_brief: White hare with long floppy ears that drag in the snow. Palette: snow white, grey tips, pale blue, violet. Crystal: crystal on an ear tip.
creatures.flavour: Leaves no tracks; it hops only on the wind-packed snow.

creatures.name: Shagcalf
creatures.visual_brief: Shaggy yak calf with a fringe over its eyes. Palette: shaggy brown, cream, horn grey, violet. Crystal: crystal braided into the fringe, later on the horn base.
creatures.flavour: Trips over its own hair and doesn't mind.

creatures.name: Shagmount
creatures.visual_brief: Massive yak with long fringe coat and sweeping horns. Palette: shaggy brown, cream, horn grey, violet. Crystal: crystal braided into the fringe, later on the horn base.
creatures.flavour: Carries travellers over the pass on its broad back.

creatures.name: Ledgebex
creatures.visual_brief: Ibex with long backswept horns, posed on a ledge. Palette: tan, white belly, curved grey horns, violet. Crystal: crystal between the horns.
creatures.flavour: Stands on cliffs no one else dares climb.

creatures.name: Talonet
creatures.visual_brief: Fluffy eaglet with oversized talons. Palette: brown, gold nape, white tail, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, final has crystal tips on the primaries.
creatures.flavour: Practises fierce looks in puddles.

creatures.name: Skyrender
creatures.visual_brief: Young eagle with long broad wings and a sharp brow. Palette: brown, gold nape, white tail, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, final has crystal tips on the primaries.
creatures.flavour: Circles the pass watching every traveller.

creatures.name: Summitalon
creatures.visual_brief: Great eagle with golden crown feathers and huge talons. Palette: brown, gold nape, white tail, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, final has crystal tips on the primaries.
creatures.flavour: Nests on the highest peak and is said to see the whole land.

creatures.name: Hoarkit
creatures.visual_brief: Arctic fox kit with frost-crisp fur. Palette: frost white, pale blue, black nose, violet. Crystal: crystal on the tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Pounces into snowdrifts and comes up giggling.

creatures.name: Rimebrush
creatures.visual_brief: Elegant arctic fox with feathery frost tail. Palette: frost white, pale blue, black nose, violet. Crystal: crystal on the tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Leaves frost patterns on every window it passes.

creatures.name: Talusmouse
creatures.visual_brief: Round mountain mouse with tiny ears among scree. Palette: grey-brown, round ears, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal on its belly.
creatures.flavour: Stacks dry grass into haypiles for winter.

creatures.name: Frostweevil
creatures.visual_brief: Weevil with a frost-coated shell and long snout. Palette: ice blue, frost white, dark legs, violet. Crystal: crystal on the snout.
creatures.flavour: Burrows in snowbanks to stay warm.

creatures.name: Knotghast
creatures.visual_brief: Ghost made of frayed rope knots. Palette: rope tan, frayed grey, ghost blue, violet. Crystal: crystal tied in a knot at its centre.
creatures.flavour: Haunts the old rope bridge and tightens loose knots.

creatures.name: Flurrin
creatures.visual_brief: Tiny snowflake sprite with six arms. Palette: snow white, pale blue, silver, violet. Crystal: crystal snowflake at the centre.
creatures.flavour: Spins down from the sky and lands on noses.

creatures.name: Squallwhirl
creatures.visual_brief: Swirling snow spirit with long flowing arms. Palette: snow white, pale blue, silver, violet. Crystal: crystal snowflake at the centre.
creatures.flavour: Whips up sudden snow squalls when angry.

creatures.name: Pardlet
creatures.visual_brief: Snow leopard cub with a huge fluffy tail. Palette: pale grey, black rosettes, ice blue eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal on the long tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Bites its own tail to stay warm.

creatures.name: Dewpard
creatures.visual_brief: Snow leopard that fades into drifting dew. Palette: pale grey, black rosettes, ice blue eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal on the long tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Stalks the pass unseen; travellers only find its prints.

creatures.name: Snowgrouse
creatures.visual_brief: Plump grouse with feathered snowshoe feet. Palette: white, mottled brown, red brow, violet. Crystal: crystal on the chest.
creatures.flavour: Changes from brown to white when the snow comes.

creatures.name: Snowcairn
creatures.visual_brief: Giant snow-and-stone mound creature with boulder fists. Palette: snow white, stone grey, ice blue, violet. Crystal: crystal set in its stone face.
creatures.flavour: Sleeps under the snow; when it stirs, the slope moves.

creatures.name: Waddlet
creatures.visual_brief: Round penguin chick in fluffy grey down. Palette: black, white belly, yellow cheeks, violet. Crystal: crystal on the chest, final has crystal ice crest.
creatures.flavour: Slides everywhere on its belly.

creatures.name: Floepaddle
creatures.visual_brief: Sleek penguin with paddle flippers and a yellow crest. Palette: black, white belly, yellow cheeks, violet. Crystal: crystal on the chest, final has crystal ice crest.
creatures.flavour: Surfs ice floes and races the others.

creatures.name: Tundrarch
creatures.visual_brief: Huge emperor-like penguin with an ice-crest crown. Palette: black, white belly, yellow cheeks, violet. Crystal: crystal on the chest, final has crystal ice crest.
creatures.flavour: Leads its colony through the longest winters.

creatures.name: Northling
creatures.visual_brief: Small floating creature with ribbon-like tails of light. Palette: pale green, pink, starry blue, violet. Crystal: crystal at the tips of its ribbon tails.
creatures.flavour: Dances in the night sky above Frostspire.

creatures.name: Skyveil
creatures.visual_brief: Long flowing light spirit with veil-like aurora wings. Palette: pale green, pink, starry blue, violet. Crystal: crystal at the tips of its ribbon tails.
creatures.flavour: Its dance turns the whole sky green and pink.

creatures.name: Snowmuff
creatures.visual_brief: Fluffy white ape baby with mitten paws. Palette: white fur, blue-grey face, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal on its forehead.
creatures.flavour: Throws snowballs at anyone who looks friendly.

creatures.name: Peakbrute
creatures.visual_brief: Hulking white ape with frosted shoulders. Palette: white fur, blue-grey face, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal on its forehead.
creatures.flavour: Guards mountain huts and asks only for warm soup in return.

creatures.name: Spirewing
creatures.visual_brief: Tall slender bird with long ribbon tail and halo. Palette: white, silver, ice blue, violet. Crystal: crystal halo behind the head.
creatures.flavour: Circles the town spire at dawn; the bells ring by themselves.

creatures.name: Chimelet
creatures.visual_brief: Small bell-shaped creature with a ribbon tail. Palette: brass gold, cream, ice blue, violet. Crystal: crystal is the clapper.
creatures.flavour: Rings softly when someone is about to sneeze.

creatures.name: Chimespire
creatures.visual_brief: Tall bell tower creature with three bells. Palette: brass gold, cream, ice blue, violet. Crystal: crystal is the clapper.
creatures.flavour: Its chime calms storms for a little while.

creatures.name: Snowroller
creatures.visual_brief: Beetle pushing a snowball bigger than itself. Palette: black shell, snow white ball, brown, violet. Crystal: crystal on the head horn.
creatures.flavour: Its snowballs become the town's snowmen.

creatures.name: Mantleox
creatures.visual_brief: Shaggy musk ox with heavy horn helmet. Palette: dark brown wool, cream horns, frost white, violet. Crystal: crystal on the horn boss.
creatures.flavour: Stands in a ring with others to guard the young.

creatures.name: Stoatling
creatures.visual_brief: Slinky stoat with a black tail tip. Palette: brown, cream belly, black tail tip, violet. Crystal: crystal on the tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Dances to confuse its prey, and also for fun.
creatures.note: Type changes dark -> light on evolution.

creatures.name: Ermibright
creatures.visual_brief: Pure white ermine with glowing tail tip. Palette: brown, cream belly, black tail tip, violet. Crystal: crystal on the tail tip.
creatures.flavour: Its white winter coat shines like fresh snow.
creatures.note: Type changes dark -> light on evolution.

creatures.name: Hearthghast
creatures.visual_brief: Ghost of a warm hearth fire with open-door mouth. Palette: hearth orange, ghost white, wood brown, violet. Crystal: crystal glows in its chest like an ember.
creatures.flavour: Haunts empty mountain huts to keep them warm for travellers.

creatures.name: Rimelet
creatures.visual_brief: Small dragon with icicle horns and frosty wings. Palette: ice blue, white, silver, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, final has crystal icicle spines.
creatures.flavour: Breathes little puffs of frost when it laughs.

creatures.name: Rimewyrm
creatures.visual_brief: Long serpentine dragon with frosted mane. Palette: ice blue, white, silver, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, final has crystal icicle spines.
creatures.flavour: Sleeps in glaciers for years.

creatures.name: Hailcrest
creatures.visual_brief: Great winged ice dragon with a crest of hail crystals. Palette: ice blue, white, silver, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, final has crystal icicle spines.
creatures.flavour: Its wingbeats bring the first snow of winter.

creatures.name: Shardhart
creatures.visual_brief: Deer with antlers of growing crystal. Palette: pale violet, white, silver, violet. Crystal: violet crystal antlers.
creatures.flavour: Rests by the crystal barrier and hums with it.

creatures.name: Quartzhopper
creatures.visual_brief: Grasshopper with clear crystal wings. Palette: clear quartz, pale green, white, violet. Crystal: crystal on its back.
creatures.flavour: Its jumps make a faint chiming sound.

creatures.name: Ridgeskink
creatures.visual_brief: Slender skink with ridged back scales. Palette: sand, rust stripes, dark brown, violet. Crystal: crystal on the head, final has crystal ridge spines.
creatures.flavour: Suns on the crystal ridge rocks all day.

creatures.name: Spinemonitor
creatures.visual_brief: Large monitor lizard with tall spine ridge. Palette: sand, rust stripes, dark brown, violet. Crystal: crystal on the head, final has crystal ridge spines.
creatures.flavour: Patrols the ridge with a slow, proud walk.

creatures.name: Zephkit
creatures.visual_brief: Fennec kit with oversized ears that catch the wind. Palette: sand gold, cream, huge ear pink, violet. Crystal: crystal on the ear base.
creatures.flavour: Hears wind changes before they happen.

creatures.name: Galefennec
creatures.visual_brief: Long-eared fox whose ears act as wind sails. Palette: sand gold, cream, huge ear pink, violet. Crystal: crystal on the ear base.
creatures.flavour: Can glide short distances on its ears.

creatures.name: Shardghast
creatures.visual_brief: Ghost made of broken crystal shards. Palette: glass grey, shadow black, pale violet, violet. Crystal: crystal shard as its core.
creatures.flavour: Rattles softly when the barrier glows.

creatures.name: Glyphlet
creatures.visual_brief: Small creature with glowing glyph markings. Palette: deep blue, gold glyphs, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal set in the centre glyph.
creatures.flavour: Draws shapes in the dirt that no one can read.

creatures.name: Glyphmage
creatures.visual_brief: Robed-looking creature with floating glyph rings. Palette: deep blue, gold glyphs, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal set in the centre glyph.
creatures.flavour: Its glyphs open locks that no key fits.

creatures.name: Seraphawk
creatures.visual_brief: Hawk with six white wings and golden eyes. Palette: white, gold, sky blue, violet. Crystal: crystal in the chest feathers.
creatures.flavour: Watches over the ridge and the travellers who cross it.

creatures.name: Lilacthorn
creatures.visual_brief: Thorny shrub creature with lilac flower clusters. Palette: lilac, deep green, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal bloom at its centre.
creatures.flavour: Smells sweet and pricks anyone who picks its flowers.

creatures.name: Helioseed
creatures.visual_brief: Sunflower seedling with a tiny face in the bud. Palette: sunflower yellow, leaf green, seed brown, violet. Crystal: crystal at the seed-head centre.
creatures.flavour: Turns to follow the sun all day.

creatures.name: Heliobloom
creatures.visual_brief: Tall sunflower creature with leaf arms and a huge face bloom. Palette: sunflower yellow, leaf green, seed brown, violet. Crystal: crystal at the seed-head centre.
creatures.flavour: Shares its seeds with every bird in the meadow.

creatures.name: Sunquail
creatures.visual_brief: Plump quail with a golden head plume. Palette: gold, cream, rust speckles, violet. Crystal: crystal at the crest.
creatures.flavour: Runs in lines with its family through tall grass.

creatures.name: Sunspeckle
creatures.visual_brief: Round ladybird with glowing sun spots. Palette: red-gold shell, sun spots, black, violet. Crystal: one of the spots is the crystal.
creatures.flavour: Counts its spots every morning to be sure.

creatures.name: Lopecalf
creatures.visual_brief: Wobbly bison calf with a curly forelock. Palette: tawny brown, cream muzzle, dark horn, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, final has crystal studs on the hump.
creatures.flavour: Follows anything that walks steadily.

creatures.name: Plainhorn
creatures.visual_brief: Young bison with curved horns and a shaggy hump. Palette: tawny brown, cream muzzle, dark horn, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, final has crystal studs on the hump.
creatures.flavour: Grazes the uplands in big slow herds.

creatures.name: Stampedor
creatures.visual_brief: Massive bison with heavy horns and a mane like a storm. Palette: tawny brown, cream muzzle, dark horn, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow, final has crystal studs on the hump.
creatures.flavour: When a herd of them runs, the ground drums for miles.

creatures.name: Popgopher
creatures.visual_brief: Gopher that pops up and down from holes. Palette: sandy brown, pink nose, cream cheeks, violet. Crystal: crystal on the forehead.
creatures.flavour: Pops up to say hello and is gone before you answer.

creatures.name: Thermalark
creatures.visual_brief: Skylark that rises straight up on warm air. Palette: streaked brown, cream, sky blue, violet. Crystal: crystal on the throat.
creatures.flavour: Sings higher than any other bird and never lands mid-song.

creatures.name: Sicklet
creatures.visual_brief: Little mantis with leaf-blade forearms. Palette: grass green, straw gold, red eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal on the head.
creatures.flavour: Bows politely before every battle.

creatures.name: Reapmantis
creatures.visual_brief: Tall mantis with long blade-like leaf arms and a crested head. Palette: grass green, straw gold, red eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal on the head.
creatures.flavour: Trims the meadow grass in neat patterns.

creatures.name: Basklet
creatures.visual_brief: Lizard that glows warmer the longer it suns. Palette: sand orange, red stripes, gold eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal on the back, final has a crystal crest.
creatures.flavour: Basks so long its scales start to glow.

creatures.name: Sunbasilisk
creatures.visual_brief: Frilled lizard with a sunburst neck frill. Palette: sand orange, red stripes, gold eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal on the back, final has a crystal crest.
creatures.flavour: Spreads its frill to soak up heat, then glows all night.

creatures.name: Dialmoss
creatures.visual_brief: Sundial-shaped stone creature with a bronze fin on its back. Palette: weathered stone, bronze gnomon, moss, violet. Crystal: crystal at the tip of the gnomon.
creatures.flavour: Always knows the hour, even on cloudy days.

creatures.name: Dewbell
creatures.visual_brief: Bell-shaped flower that holds a drop of water. Palette: petal blue, leaf green, dew white, violet. Crystal: crystal droplet in the bell.
creatures.flavour: Shares a sip of water with thirsty travellers.

creatures.name: Jestrix
creatures.visual_brief: Hare with jester-like patterned ears. Palette: harlequin purple, gold, black, violet. Crystal: crystal bell on the tip of one ear.
creatures.flavour: Plays harmless tricks and laughs loudest when caught.

creatures.name: Aurelmare
creatures.visual_brief: White mare with feathered wings at the hooves and a gold mane. Palette: white, gold, sky blue, violet. Crystal: crystal set in the brow.
creatures.flavour: Gallops across the uplands at sunrise.

creatures.name: Glisterdew
creatures.visual_brief: Sundew plant creature with sticky glittering tendrils. Palette: red tendrils, green leaves, dew sparkle, violet. Crystal: crystal is the dew drop on the tallest tendril.
creatures.flavour: Catches bugs, then lets them go after a little chat.

creatures.name: Pollenub
creatures.visual_brief: Bear cub dusted in yellow pollen. Palette: honey brown, pollen yellow, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal on the muzzle.
creatures.flavour: Sneezes clouds of pollen when it laughs.

creatures.name: Fenflick
creatures.visual_brief: Tiny floating light with a wisp tail. Palette: pale green glow, dusk grey, yellow, violet. Crystal: crystal is the glowing core.
creatures.flavour: Blinks on and off across the bog at night.

creatures.name: Bogbeacon
creatures.visual_brief: Floating light spirit with three bobbing lantern lights. Palette: pale green glow, dusk grey, yellow, violet. Crystal: crystal is the glowing core.
creatures.flavour: Leads travellers in circles until they laugh.

creatures.name: Peatfrog
creatures.visual_brief: Squat frog with a round orange throat sac. Palette: peat brown, olive, orange throat, violet. Crystal: crystal on the back.
creatures.flavour: Croaks in chorus with a thousand others.

creatures.name: Peatbellow
creatures.visual_brief: Huge frog with a booming throat sac. Palette: peat brown, olive, orange throat, violet. Crystal: crystal on the back.
creatures.flavour: Its croak rattles windows in the next town.

creatures.name: Reedcrane
creatures.visual_brief: Tall crane with long legs and a red crown patch. Palette: dusk grey, white, red crown, violet. Crystal: crystal on the crown.
creatures.flavour: Dances in the dusk with its partner every spring.

creatures.name: Bogsnout
creatures.visual_brief: Baby crocodile with a long snout and big eyes. Palette: mud green, olive, cream belly, violet. Crystal: crystal on the snout, final has crystal scutes.
creatures.flavour: Floats like a log and giggles when found.

creatures.name: Mirejaw
creatures.visual_brief: Crocodile with a mossy back and a wide grin. Palette: mud green, olive, cream belly, violet. Crystal: crystal on the snout, final has crystal scutes.
creatures.flavour: Waits patiently in reed beds.

creatures.name: Fenmaw
creatures.visual_brief: Huge armoured crocodile with peat-moss ridges. Palette: mud green, olive, cream belly, violet. Crystal: crystal on the snout, final has crystal scutes.
creatures.flavour: Ruler of the deep pools; even Mirewump moves aside.

creatures.name: Skimnymph
creatures.visual_brief: Dragonfly nymph with big eyes and stubby wings. Palette: teal, green, clear wings, violet. Crystal: crystal at the tail end.
creatures.flavour: Skims the water surface in short hops.

creatures.name: Bogdart
creatures.visual_brief: Large dragonfly with four shimmering wings. Palette: teal, green, clear wings, violet. Crystal: crystal at the tail end.
creatures.flavour: Darts over the bog faster than the eye can follow.

creatures.name: Turfhulk
creatures.visual_brief: Hulking mound of peat and roots with moss shoulders. Palette: peat black, moss green, reed tan, violet. Crystal: crystal buried in its chest.
creatures.flavour: Sinks into the bog to sleep and rises with the dusk.

creatures.name: Murkgleam
creatures.visual_brief: Dusk bank with a pair of round eyes. Palette: dusk white, murky green, black eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal flickers inside the dusk.
creatures.flavour: Rolls over the boardwalks and hides them for fun.

creatures.name: Pitchergulp
creatures.visual_brief: Pitcher plant creature with a lid hat. Palette: pitcher red, green, yellow lip, violet. Crystal: crystal on the lid.
creatures.flavour: Slurps rainwater and burps bubbles.

creatures.name: Bulrusher
creatures.visual_brief: Muskrat that rushes through bulrushes. Palette: brown, reed green, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal on its forehead.
creatures.flavour: Builds reed houses and lets others share them.

creatures.name: Mirewump
creatures.visual_brief: Hippo-toad with reeds growing from its back. Palette: hippo grey-green, reed tan, pink mouth, violet. Crystal: violet pebbles on its back.
creatures.flavour: Lazy, grumpy and very sure the whole bog belongs to it.
creatures.note: Scripted Cosmic Mirewump in the Tideglide storm (SOUL_PLAYBOOK 1.7).

creatures.name: Runeskein
creatures.visual_brief: Yarn-woven ferret with a bead pin. Palette: yarn cream, teal, rust, violet. Crystal: violet bead pin.
creatures.flavour: Thoughtful. When it is hurt, it unravels and weaves itself back.
creatures.note: Encounters: Mirefen at night; notes also list Lanternport/Aurelith.

creatures.name: Mireglim
creatures.visual_brief: Small swamp imp with a glowing eye and forked tail. Palette: murk green, black, yellow eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal on its forked tail.
creatures.flavour: Hides in hollow logs and giggles at travellers.

creatures.name: Gloommire
creatures.visual_brief: Hunched swamp demon with a moss cloak and long arms. Palette: murk green, black, yellow eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal on its forked tail.
creatures.flavour: Brings the dusk in at dusk and takes it away at dawn.

creatures.name: Glimmoth
creatures.visual_brief: Pale moth whose wings shed dew. Palette: dusk grey, pale violet, white, violet. Crystal: crystal on the head.
creatures.flavour: Only flies when dusk is thick.

creatures.name: Kneeroot
creatures.visual_brief: Little cypress knee root with a face. Palette: cypress brown, moss green, grey, violet. Crystal: crystal set in a knee root.
creatures.flavour: Pokes out of the water and pretends to be a stump.

creatures.name: Cypresshade
creatures.visual_brief: Cypress tree creature draped in hanging moss. Palette: cypress brown, moss green, grey, violet. Crystal: crystal set in a knee root.
creatures.flavour: Shades the bog and its creatures on hot days.

creatures.name: Silteel
creatures.visual_brief: Mud eel that hides in silt. Palette: mud brown, olive, gold eyes, violet. Crystal: crystal on the head.
creatures.flavour: Wriggles under boardwalks and tickles feet.

creatures.name: Duckmoss
creatures.visual_brief: Duck covered in floating duckweed. Palette: duckweed green, brown, orange bill, violet. Crystal: crystal on the bill.
creatures.flavour: Paddles through the bog and is mistaken for a floating green patch.

creatures.name: Mudwhisk
creatures.visual_brief: Catfish with long whiskers and a flat head. Palette: mud brown, long whiskers, cream belly, violet. Crystal: crystal on the brow.
creatures.flavour: Knows every hidden pool in the bog.

creatures.name: Sprinkit
creatures.visual_brief: Small blue pup with droplet-shaped ears. Palette: rain blue, slate grey, white, violet. Crystal: crystal on the nose, final has a crystal raindrop crest.
creatures.flavour: Shakes off rain all over its friends on purpose.

creatures.name: Downpaw
creatures.visual_brief: Lean blue dog with cloud-puff fur on its legs. Palette: rain blue, slate grey, white, violet. Crystal: crystal on the nose, final has a crystal raindrop crest.
creatures.flavour: Runs along the flooded road splashing happily.

creatures.name: Deluvane
creatures.visual_brief: Large hound with a rain-cloud mane trailing drizzle. Palette: rain blue, slate grey, white, violet. Crystal: crystal on the nose, final has a crystal raindrop crest.
creatures.flavour: Walks ahead of storms; farmers welcome it in dry years.

creatures.name: Petrelet
creatures.visual_brief: Small storm petrel chick with wet-look feathers. Palette: storm grey, white belly, black wingtips, violet. Crystal: crystal on the forehead.
creatures.flavour: Patters across puddles as if walking on water.

creatures.name: Galepetrel
creatures.visual_brief: Storm petrel with long angled wings. Palette: storm grey, white belly, black wingtips, violet. Crystal: crystal on the forehead.
creatures.flavour: Flies into storms, never away from them.

creatures.name: Parasoleaf
creatures.visual_brief: Creature carrying a huge leaf like an umbrella. Palette: leaf green, stem brown, rain blue, violet. Crystal: crystal at the leaf tip.
creatures.flavour: Shelters smaller creatures during storms.

creatures.name: Drenchcrab
creatures.visual_brief: Crab that loves storms, with drip-shaped spots. Palette: slate blue, white spots, orange claws, violet. Crystal: crystal on the shell centre.
creatures.flavour: Comes out by the hundred when it rains.

creatures.name: Slurrymole
creatures.visual_brief: Mole with slick clay-coated fur. Palette: wet clay, brown, pink nose, violet. Crystal: crystal on its digging claw.
creatures.flavour: Digs tunnels that fill with rainwater for others to swim in.

creatures.name: Brinehopper
creatures.visual_brief: Sand hopper with springy legs. Palette: sand grey, sea green, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal on the back.
creatures.flavour: Jumps along flood lines after storms.

creatures.name: Surfskipper
creatures.visual_brief: Water strider with long wave-skimming legs. Palette: sand grey, sea green, cream, violet. Crystal: crystal on the back.
creatures.flavour: Skips over waves like a stone.

creatures.name: Driftknot
creatures.visual_brief: Knotted driftwood creature with kelp hair. Palette: driftwood grey, kelp green, white, violet. Crystal: crystal knot in its grain.
creatures.flavour: Washes ashore after each storm somewhere new.

creatures.name: Reefhatch
creatures.visual_brief: Sea turtle hatchling with a flipper wave. Palette: sea green, sand shell, coral pink, violet. Crystal: crystal on the shell, final has crystal palms growing on its shell.
creatures.flavour: Races to the sea under the moon.

creatures.name: Reefshell
creatures.visual_brief: Sea turtle with coral growing on its shell. Palette: sea green, sand shell, coral pink, violet. Crystal: crystal on the shell, final has crystal palms growing on its shell.
creatures.flavour: Swims the reef carrying little fish friends.

creatures.name: Atollback
creatures.visual_brief: Gigantic sea turtle whose shell is a tiny island with sand and coral. Palette: sea green, sand shell, coral pink, violet. Crystal: crystal on the shell, final has crystal palms growing on its shell.
creatures.flavour: Sailors once mistook a resting one for land.

creatures.name: Puffling
